dogecoin.text: #dogecoin going nuts today, just hit a new all time high of 44c. I'm up almost 800$ 😅❤️ #HODL

Huh.. #dogecoin was at 41c for a moment there. Trying to #HODL but every time it gets closer to its last high I get nervous. #DogeDay was hot garbage. Hoping for at least 55 or 60c realistically by Saturday, but keeping a close eye.

I just paid off all 4 of my credit cards. I'm still kinda in shock, not gonna lie. Making money off a meme coin and just tossing in some money here and there.. Still trying to process. 😅 Excuse me while I just stare blankly. #dogecoin #thankful

Wellll damn.. Haha, TFW you have a limit sell on Dogecoin because you think it won't even get close to it... Then you wake up and they all sold. 2600$ profit, on a meme. The internet and crypto is weird. Was a wild ride but no way am I buying more unless it dips below 20c 😁
